\begin{aligned}8\cdot\left(\frac{\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta({cos}^{2}⁡\theta+{sin}^{2}⁡\theta)+1}{{cos}^{2}⁡\theta}\right) & =8\cdot\left(\frac{\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta\cdot 1+1}{{cos}^{2}⁡\theta}\right) \\  & =8\cdot\left(\frac{\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta+1}{{cos}^{2}⁡\theta}\right) \\  & =8\cdot\left(\frac{\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta}{{cos}^{2}⁡\theta}+\frac{1}{{cos}^{2}⁡\theta}\right) \\  & =8\cdot\left(\frac{\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta}{\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta\cdot \operatorname{cos}⁡\theta}+\frac{1}{{cos}^{2}⁡\theta}\right) \\  & =8\cdot\left(\frac{\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta\cancel{\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta}}{\cancel{\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta}\cdot \operatorname{cos}⁡\theta}+\frac{1}{{cos}^{2}⁡\theta}\right) \\  & =8\cdot\left(\frac{\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta}{\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta}+{(\frac{1}{\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta})}^{2}\right) \\  & =8\cdot\left(\operatorname{tan}⁡\theta+{sec}^{2}⁡\theta\right)\end{aligned}

$$
8\cdot\left(\frac{\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta{cos}^{3}⁡\theta+\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta{sin}^{3}⁡\theta+1}{{cos}^{2}⁡\theta}\right)=8\cdot\left(\operatorname{tan}⁡\theta+{sec}^{2}⁡\theta\right).
$$
